products.description:
Adopt an iconic archival look in this blue adidas Originals Men's adicolor Classics 3-Stripes Hoodie. This timeless piece features a soft fleece fabric and a relaxed fit, making it perfect for everyday casual wear. The embroidered Trefoil logo and the 3-Stripes down each sleeve add a pop of style that is true to the classic design.
  • Regular fit
  • Drawcord-adjustable hood
  • 70% cotton, 30% polyester (recycled)
  • Kangaroo pocket
  • Ribbed hem and cuffs
